versions.changelog: La skill puente ahora se llama f100k-puente

Initial release of UX Elevación Formula100K skill.

- Provides design enhancement commands and natural language triggers for Next.js 16 + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui stack.
- Includes actionable templates for common UI/UX improvement requests in Spanish.
- Defines design quality principles (variance, motion, density) and when to apply them.
- Outlines explicit commands (/polish, /craft, /animate, etc.) and implicit trigger phrases.
- Offers clear instructions for users to request high-quality UI/UX interventions, even without technical knowledge.
- Designed for use within OpenClaw agent setup; references to file/code access and peer review instructions included.
